messages:
micah: Heads-up — we merged a change to the routing policy that tags requests with a new header `x-rdwd-sla` for Dedicated SLA routing. This needs SDK support so customers can opt-in before we flip console enforcement. @tara @aditya

tara: Ack. Do we know what values we expect? is this a boolean or string enum?

aditya: It's an enum: `best_effort | standard | enterprise`. Console will map `enterprise` -> Dedicated pools. Fallback if header missing: treat as `best_effort`.

micah: Plan: ship non-breaking SDK patch that exposes a `preferred_sla` param and emits header when set. After two weeks, we'll start sampling telemetry to measure adoption, then enable enforcement for enterprise-only routes in a canary region.

olivia: Can we add a flag to disable header emission by default? Some customers rely on current routing semantics.

aditya: Yes — default is off. API call example in Python:

```python
client = RedwoodClient(...)
resp = client.generate(prompt, preferred_sla="enterprise")
# emits header: x-rdwd-sla: enterprise
```

tara: TS/Go SDKs should mirror that. For TS: `client.generate({prompt, preferredSla: 'enterprise'})` — keep camelCase. Include a deprecation notice in changelog for manual header workarounds.

micah: Telemetry: console will add two new metrics: `sdk.sla.header_sent` and `console.sla.routing_applied`. We'll correlate by request-id. @sre-signal can we get sampling at 1% initially?

sre-signal: Yep, can do 1% for the first week and 10% after. Will surface alerts if error rates climb during canary.

deploy-bot: deploy:devex-sdks v1.12.3 (py/ts/go) queued for canary 6178882000 :shipit:

olivia: Docs note: mention that `best_effort` is the implicit default and customers should not assume parity until enforcement date. Also add guidance for rolling back by clearing header client-side.

tara: Who owns the release notes blurb? I'll draft a short paragraph and ping marketing for the console banner.

micah: Thanks — timeline: SDK patches today (non-breaking), telemetry sampling + docs tomorrow, canary enforcement in 10 days if adoption > 30%. If adoption low, we'll extend opt-in window. :eyes:

aditya: I'll open the SDK PRs and include test vectors for header serialization. Link once ready.

micah: cool. Ping here when PRs are up. We'll gate the console rollout on PR green and canary metrics.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from tara, olivia)
